notes: Episodes 535-545 date to summer 5752 (1992) on Tuesdays 30 Jun to 15 Sep 1992. The anchors are 537 ('today is Yud-Gimmel Tammuz' = Tue 14 Jul 1992) and 545 ('tonight is Chai Elul' = Tue 15 Sep 1992), plus candle-lighting times and the prayers for the Rebbe's recovery (after Adar 5752).

No new episode seems to have aired in the week of 25 Aug 1992: 542 is before Shabbos Mevarchim Elul (18 Aug) and 543 is already in Elul (1 Sep). However, 542's candle time (7:16) fits 28 Aug, so 542 may have been re-aired or re-edited for 25 Aug.

Catalog row 543 is blank; it is the final chapter (3) of 'Reb Asher the Melamed'. Rows 544 and 545 are also blank: 544 = the farmer boy and the bugle (shofar parable), 545 = the young Baal Shem Tov in the cave (Chai Elul).

539 is largely a rerun of material from episodes 135, 236 and 486 (the Tzivos Hashem join appeal, Rabbi Akiva and negel vasser, and the drunken-father story) with a new refuah-shleimah close. The worked example 86349c08d6 ('The Drunken Father 21') says its story re-aired in 539, so pass 2 should link 539 to episode 21 / 86349c08d6.
535's story chapter repeats episode 130 (1d0f28c0a0), so 'The Ten Wedding Gifts' first aired around episodes 129-131. Chapter 1 (episode 534) is not in this batch.
544's bugle story = episode 291 (d2b1059d0e); 545's cave story = episode 395 (ec9db14f6a).
Several Shema guests and a visiting teacher share the host's family name (Goldstein), and a teacher is named in 536, 544 and 545. They may be the host's relatives. They are kept in hidden only.
ASR spells the poritz's son in 'The Ten Wedding Gifts' as 'Brewster'/'Rooster'; the real name is uncertain, so public text avoids it.
